eventStreams.name: OrderStream
eventStreams.description: Real-time POS and online order transactions
kqlAggregations: OrderStreamEvents | summarize TotalRevenue=sum(Amount), OrderCount=count(), AvgOrderValue=avg(Amount) by Channel, bin(Timestamp, 1m)
OrderStreamEvents | summarize Revenue=sum(Amount), Items=sum(Quantity) by StoreID, bin(Timestamp, 1h)

eventStreams.name: InventoryMovements
eventStreams.description: Real-time stock level changes across warehouses and stores
kqlAggregations: InventoryMovementEvents | summarize TotalIn=sumif(QuantityChange, MovementType == 'Receipt'), TotalOut=sumif(QuantityChange, MovementType == 'Sale'), Alerts=countif(IsAlertTriggered) by WarehouseID, bin(Timestamp, 15m)
InventoryMovementEvents | where IsAlertTriggered == true | summarize AlertCount=count() by ProductID, WarehouseID, bin(Timestamp, 1h)

eventStreams.name: WebClickstream
eventStreams.description: Real-time page views, clicks, and cart events from the e-commerce platform
kqlAggregations: WebClickstreamEvents | summarize PageViews=countif(EventType == 'PageView'), AddToCart=countif(EventType == 'AddToCart'), Purchases=countif(EventType == 'Purchase') by bin(Timestamp, 1m)
WebClickstreamEvents | summarize Sessions=dcount(SessionID), AvgCartValue=avg(CartValue) by DeviceType, TrafficSource, bin(Timestamp, 5m)

bridgeQueries.name: OrderBridge
bridgeQueries.description: Bridge hot order stream with cold Lakehouse sales data

bridgeQueries.name: InventoryBridge
bridgeQueries.description: Bridge real-time inventory movements with inventory snapshots
